# Format-3 worked source and virtual document
`main.orna` is language source; `data.orna` is a virtual schema-directed row
document; `database.orna` is literal bootstrap metadata. They are different
contexts, not three interchangeable programs. The content.mp3 path is an
illustrative virtual field, not a missing packaged song. Use the original
synthetic tone/pixel inputs under examples/blob-library/ for real import tests.
No new compiler/runtime execution is claimed for these examples.
